benchmark_trials.name: STRIVE
benchmark_trials.title: Study of Ivacaftor in Cystic Fibrosis Subjects Aged 12 Years and Older With the G551D Mutation
primary_endpoint: Absolute Mean Change From Baseline in Percent Predicted Forced Expiratory Volume in 1 Second (FEV1) Through Week 24
benchmark_trials.citation: Ramsey BW et al., N Engl J Med 2011;365:1663-1672

benchmark_trials.name: TRAFFIC
benchmark_trials.title: A Study of Lumacaftor in Combination With Ivacaftor in Cystic Fibrosis Subjects Aged 12 Years and Older Who Are Homozygous for the F508del-CFTR Mutation
primary_endpoint: Absolute Change From Baseline in Percent Predicted Forced Expiratory Volume in 1 Second (FEV1) at Week 24
benchmark_trials.citation: Wainwright CE et al., N Engl J Med 2015;373:220-231

benchmark_trials.name: AURORA-44
benchmark_trials.title: A Phase 3 Study of VX-445 Combination Therapy in Subjects With Cystic Fibrosis Heterozygous for the F508del Mutation and a Minimal Function Mutation (F/MF)
primary_endpoint: Absolute Change in Percent Predicted Forced Expiratory Volume in 1 Second (ppFEV1)
benchmark_trials.citation: Middleton PG et al., N Engl J Med 2019;381:1809-1819

benchmark_trials.name: SKYLINE 102
benchmark_trials.title: A Phase 3 Study of VX-121 Combination Therapy in Participants With Cystic Fibrosis (CF) Heterozygous for F508del and a Minimal Function Mutation (F/MF)
primary_endpoint: Absolute Change in Percent Predicted Forced Expiratory Volume in 1 Second (ppFEV1)

benchmark_trials.name: BEACON-CF
benchmark_trials.title: A Phase 1/2 Study of VX-522 in Participants With Cystic Fibrosis (CF)
benchmark_trials.population: CF adults ineligible for CFTR modulators
primary_endpoint: Safety and Tolerability as Assessed by Number of Participants With Adverse Events (AEs) and Serious Adverse Events (SAEs)

care_team_guide.title: Care Team Reader Guide
what_the_atlas_can_answer: Prevalence and longitudinal shift of registered primary endpoint classes across 940 interventional CF trials (pre-2012, 2012-2019, 2020-2026).
Distribution of primary trial endpoints across clinical phases (Phase 1 through Phase 4).
Whether trial protocols evaluate specific physiological or patient-reported measures (e.g. FEV1, sweat chloride, CFQ-R, BMI, pulmonary exacerbations).
Co-tagging patterns where measures capture both efficacy parameters and safety surveillance (e.g. multi-class tagging).
what_the_atlas_cannot_answer: Individual patient treatment decisions, personalized medical recommendations, or clinical practice directives.
Regulatory efficacy or safety clearance (ClinicalTrials.gov registrations reflect sponsor filings, not agency approval determinations).
Unregistered exploratory or secondary endpoints omitted from primary protocol registrations.
Personal modulator eligibility, which depends strictly on individual CFTR genotyping and national regulatory labels.
care_team_guide.fev1_definition_and_safety_use: The lung_function_fev1 class captures all registered forced expiratory volume in one second measures, including those monitored as safety or bronchospasm checks post-dosing, which are co-tagged with safety_adverse_events under the multi_class flag rather than suppressed.
